skills.name: Same-denominator numerator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that already share a common denominator, keeping that denominator.

skills.name: LCD conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator for two unlike denominators and convert both fractions into equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Whole-part subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number parts of two mixed numbers (treating an absent whole part as zero).

skills.name: Borrowing/regrouping
skills.definition: When the direct fraction subtraction is negative, borrow one whole unit (regroup it as denominator/denominator) and add it to the fractional part before subtracting again.

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a resulting fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Whole-to-fraction rewriting
skills.definition: Rewrite a bare whole number as an equivalent mixed number with a zero-numerator fraction (whole + 0/d) so it can be subtracted against a fractional operand.

skills.name: Improper mixed-number normalization
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard mixed-number form by regrouping the extra whole unit(s) before subtracting.

skills.name: Common Denominator Conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator and convert fractions with unlike denominators into equivalent fractions sharing that denominator.

skills.name: Same-Denominator Numerator Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract numerators directly once two fractions share a common denominator.

skills.name: Fraction Simplification
skills.definition: Reduce a resulting fraction to its lowest terms when the raw subtraction result is not already fully reduced.

skills.name: Borrowing/Regrouping
skills.definition: When subtracting fraction parts yields a negative value, borrow one whole (as denominator/denominator) from the whole-number part and add it to the numerator before subtracting.

skills.name: Whole-and-Fraction Part Separation
skills.definition: Separate the whole-number and fractional components of mixed numbers or whole numbers (treating a whole number as whole+0/d) and subtract each part independently.

skills.name: Improper Mixed-Number Normalization
skills.definition: Recognize a mixed number whose fractional part's numerator is greater than or equal to its denominator and convert it into standard whole-plus-proper-fraction form before/while subtracting.

skills.name: Same-denominator numerator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that already share a common denominator and record the result over that denominator.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator of two unlike denominators and rewrite both fractions as equivalent fractions over that denominator.

skills.name: Fraction simplification
skills.definition: Reduce an intermediate or final fraction to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Whole-part subtraction and recombination
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number parts of two mixed numbers (treating a missing whole or fraction part as zero) and combine the resulting whole with the fraction part to state the final answer.

skills.name: Borrow/regroup across whole and fraction
skills.definition: When subtracting the fraction parts yields a negative value, regroup one whole unit as denominator/denominator and add it to the fraction part before subtracting, repeating if the deficit exceeds one whole.

skills.name: Whole-number-to-fraction representation
skills.definition: Rewrite a bare whole number as a mixed number with a zero numerator (whole + 0/d) so it can be subtracted from, or used to subtract, a fraction or mixed number.

skills.name: Subtract numerators (common denominator)
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that already share a common denominator (whether originally, after conversion, or after borrowing) to obtain the fraction-part difference.

skills.name: Find LCD and convert fractions
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator of two unlike denominators and rewrite both fractions as equivalent fractions over that denominator.

skills.name: Simplify fraction result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms, or recognize that a zero-numerator fraction reduces to the whole number 0.

skills.name: Borrow/regroup for negative fraction difference
skills.definition: When subtracting fraction parts yields a negative result, regroup one whole unit as d/d (including treating a bare whole number as having a 0/d fraction part) and redo the subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize improper mixed-number fraction part
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose written fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard mixed-number form before performing the subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract whole-number parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of two mixed numbers, or of a mixed number and a whole number.

skills.name: Like-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that already share a common denominator, keeping that denominator.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find the LCD of two unlike denominators and rewrite both fractions as equivalent fractions over that denominator.

skills.name: Whole-number part subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of mixed numbers, treating a bare integer as having a zero fraction part when needed.

skills.name: Borrowing for negative fraction result
skills.definition: When subtracting the fraction parts yields a negative value, borrow one whole unit (as denominator/denominator) from the whole part and redo the fraction subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a resulting fraction that is not already in lowest terms to its simplest equivalent form.

skills.name: Normalize improper mixed number
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number whose fractional part is greater than or equal to one by moving the excess whole units out of the fraction into the whole-number part.
